title: Habagat to bring rains over northern Philippines
desc: The Southwest Monsoon, locally known as "habagat," is expected to bring rains to the northern parts of the Philippines on Sunday, July 19.

title: Scientists identify the rare meteorite that killed the dinosaurs 66 million years ago
desc: The asteroid that wiped out the dinosaurs was likely an exceptionally rare CO chondrite from a distant region of the solar system. Its unusual chemistry suggests that planet-cooling dust and debris, rather than sulfur inside the asteroid, may have delivered the deadliest blow.

title: Reject racial division to protect nation's independence, says PM Anwar
desc: IPOH: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim has urged Malaysians to reject attempts to sow racial division, stressing that the nation's independence was achieved through the unity and collective sacrifices of all communities.

title: US completes eighth night of strikes on Iran, targets IRGC forces over Jordan attack | Watch
desc: The US military said it completed its eighth consecutive night of strikes on Iran, targeting IRGC forces linked to the deadly Jordan attack and key Iranian military facilities.

title: Pakistan cybercrime agency summons ex-PM Khan’s sister for ‘offensive’ remarks against state institutions
desc: ISLAMABAD: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) has summoned former prime minister Imran Khan’s sister Noreen Niazi for an inquiry next week, accusing her of disseminating “false, offensive and inflammatory” content against state institutions on social media.
